title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-006
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA correspondence and news clippings regarding a 1986 JAL UFO sighting, alongside unrelated personal claims and UFO-related literature advertisements.

encounters.summary: JAL Captain Kenjyu Terauchi reported his Boeing 747 cargo jet was shadowed by two belts of light and a huge spaceship the size of two aircraft carriers while crossing into Alaska.
